// One-hot state encoding: the state is encoded as the one-hot binary value of
// a 3-bit register, directly feeding into the combinational output logic.
module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  x,
    input  [2:0] y,
    output reg Y0,
    output reg z
);
    reg [2:0] sreg;
    always @(posedge clk) begin
        case ({sreg, x})
            3'b0000: begin Y0=1; z=0; sreg=3'b000; end
            3'b0001: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b001; end
            3'b0010: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b001; end
            3'b0011: begin Y0=1; z=1; sreg=3'b001; end
            3'b0100: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b010; end
            3'b0101: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b001; end
            3'b0110: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b001; end
            3'b0111: begin Y0=1; z=1; sreg=3'b001; end
            3'b1000: begin Y0=0; z=1; sreg=3'b011; end
            3'b1001: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b100; end
            default: begin Y0=0; z=0; sreg=3'b000; end
        endcase
    end
endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  x,
    input  [2:0] y,
    output reg Y0,
    output reg z
);
    reg [2:0] state, nextstate;
    always @(*) begin
        case ({x, state, y}) inside
            // Next state is independent of x -> register-register FSM.
            // Equivalent to the long-standing register-register FSM,
            // Trevor Wilson.
            {1'b0, 3'd0, 3'd0}: begin nextstate = 3'd0; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b0, 3'd0, 3'd1}: begin nextstate = 3'd1; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b0, 3'd1, 3'd0}: begin nextstate = 3'd1; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b0, 3'd1, 3'd1}: begin nextstate = 3'd2; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b0, 3'd2, 3'd1}: begin nextstate = 3'd1; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b0, 3'd2, 3'd2}: begin nextstate = 3'd3; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b1, 3'd0, 3'd0}: begin nextstate = 3'd0; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b1, 3'd0, 3'd1}: begin nextstate = 3'd1; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b1, 3'd1, 3'd0}: begin nextstate = 3'd1; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b1, 3'd1, 3'd1}: begin nextstate = 3'd2; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b1; end
            {1'b1, 3'd2, 3'd1}: begin nextstate = 3'd1; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {1'b1, 3'd2, 3'd2}: begin nextstate = 3'd3; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b1; end
            default: begin nextstate = 3'd0; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) state <= nextstate;
    always @(posedge clk) Y0 <= state[0];
endmodule

module TopModule(
    input  clk,
    input  x,
    input  [2:0] y,
    output reg Y0,
    output reg z
);
    reg [2:0] sreg;
    reg [2:0] next_sreg;
    always @(*) begin
        case ({sreg, x})
            // Next state function: go to the one matching the y[2:0] and x
            // (the first match in the list has priority).
            // Output function: the second value of the matching pair.
            {3'b000, 1'b0}: begin next_sreg = 3'b000; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {3'b000, 1'b1}: begin next_sreg = 3'b001; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {3'b001, 1'b0}: begin next_sreg = 3'b001; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {3'b001, 1'b1}: begin next_sreg = 3'b100; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {3'b010, 1'b0}: begin next_sreg = 3'b010; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {3'b010, 1'b1}: begin next_sreg = 3'b001; Y0 = 1'b0; z = 1'b0; end
            {3'b011, 1'b0}: begin next_sreg = 3'b001; Y0 = 1'b1; z = 1'b1; end
            {3'b011, 1'b1}: begin next_sreg = 3'b010; Y0 = 1'b1; z = 1'b1; end
            {3'b100, 1'b0}: begin next_sreg = 3'b011; Y0 = 1'b1; z = 1'b1; end
            {3'b100, 1'b1}: begin next_sreg = 3'b100; Y0 = 1'b1; z = 1'b1; end
            default: begin next_sreg = 3'bx; Y0 = 1'bx; z = 1'bx; end
        endcase
    end
    always @(posedge clk) sreg <= next_sreg;
endmodule
